search_log: Opened each sibling's WVO record (74, 98, 153, 175) before fetching, per the brief: all four are 'Aan August van Saksen' (Willem -> August, same direction and correspondence run as targets 53/126), each with an explicit cipher+solution note in Opmerkingen (74: 'postscriptum in geheimschrift, waarvan op f. 19 de ontcijfering'; 98: 'postscriptum in cijfer met de oplossing'; 153: 'twee post data, waarvan de laatste in cijferschrift, waarvan 2 oplossingen'; 175: 'enige gedeelten in (opgelost) cijferschrift'). All four fetched in full (no sibling excluded) since all four record notes already promised a solution before fetching, unlike NB4 where candidates had to be found by a blind site search first.

confirmed: Six cipher designs observed across this correspondence circle, none identical: 53/57 use letters+arbitrary symbols (Λ, Δ); 74/126 use different arbitrary-symbol repertoires; 98/153 use pure numerals (153's design, overlined, differs from 98's numeral+symbol mix); 175 is interlinear rather than block cipher. A solver pass should not assume one key covers all six letters even though all are Willem<->August in the same 1561-67 window. See inventory.tsv for full per-page detail. Not transcribed.
